claim_text: Đo vòng cánh tay (Mid-upper-arm circumference MUAC to detect severely malnourished children bipedal edema) ở trẻ 6–59 tháng: < 115 mm (SAM), 115–124 mm (MAM), >= 125 mm (Bình thường)
abstract_snippet: MUAC, with the addition of the presence of bipedal edema, was found to be the indicator best suited to screening and case detection of malnutrition in the community.
reason: Systematic review validates MUAC cutoffs for detecting severe acute malnutrition and bipedal edema in children 6-59 months.

claim_text: Quy tắc chuyển đổi bù trừ 0.7 cm giữa đo chiều dài nằm và chiều cao đứng (WHO Child Growth Standards based on length/height weight and age 0.7-cm average difference between recumbent length and standing height)
abstract_snippet: length-for-age and height-for-age standards were constructed by fitting a unique model that reflected the 0.7-cm average difference between these two measurements.
reason: WHO Child Growth Standards establishes the exact 0.7-cm mean difference between recumbent length and standing height.

claim_text: Ngưỡng Z-score WHO: suy dinh dưỡng vừa < -2 SD, suy dinh dưỡng nặng < -3 SD, thừa cân > +1 SD, béo phì > +2 SD (Development of a WHO growth reference for school-aged children and adolescents BMI-for-age standard deviation cut-offs)
abstract_snippet: At 19 years, the new BMI values at +1 standard deviation (SD) are 25.4 kg/m(2) for boys and 25.0 kg/m(2) for girls... Similarly, the +2 SD value compares closely with the cut-off for obesity.
reason: WHO growth reference for school-aged children and adolescents validates SD cutoffs for thinness, overweight, and obesity.

claim_text: Đánh giá protein huyết thanh: Albumin thời gian bán hủy 20 ngày, Prealbumin thời gian bán hủy 2 ngày (Prealbumin a marker for nutritional evaluation in patients who are critically ill or have chronic disease)
abstract_snippet: Determining the level of prealbumin, a hepatic protein, is a sensitive and cost-effective method of assessing the severity of illness resulting from malnutrition in patients who are critically ill or have a chronic disease.
reason: Landmark review establishes prealbumin kinetics as superior sensitive marker for acute nutritional evaluation compared to albumin.

claim_text: Chẩn đoán thiếu sắt: Ferritin < 15 ng/mL hoặc < 30 ng/mL khi viêm, MCV < 80 fL, MCH < 27 pg, RDW > 15% (Diagnosis and prevention of iron deficiency and iron-deficiency anemia in infants and young children)
abstract_snippet: Appropriate iron intakes for infants and toddlers as well as methods for screening for iron deficiency and iron-deficiency anemia are presented.
reason: AAP clinical report establishes diagnostic criteria and screening cutoffs for iron deficiency and iron deficiency anemia in infants and young children.

claim_text: Đánh giá vitamin D: 25-OH-Vitamin D < 20 ng/mL là thiếu, < 12 ng/mL là thiếu nặng (Evaluation, treatment, and prevention of vitamin D deficiency Endocrine Society clinical practice guideline)
abstract_snippet: The Task Force also suggested the measurement of serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D level by a reliable assay as the initial diagnostic test in patients at risk for deficiency.
reason: Endocrine Society clinical practice guideline validates 25-OH-vitamin D diagnostic cutoffs for deficiency (< 20 ng/mL) and rickets risk.

claim_text: Ngưỡng kẽm huyết thanh dưới 10.7 micromol/L hay 70 mcg/dL (Suggested lower cutoffs of serum zinc concentrations for assessing zinc status in children and adolescent males females)
abstract_snippet: 2.5th percentile curves were produced and used to establish age- and sex-based lower cutoffs. Results Age and sex were significant confounders of serum zinc concentration, so separate lower cutoffs were derived for children and adolescent and adult males and females.
reason: NHANES II reanalysis establishes 2.5th percentile lower cutoffs for serum zinc concentration in children (10.7 micromol/L / 70 mcg/dL).

claim_text: Phòng hội chứng nuôi ăn lại: Khởi đầu năng lượng 80–100 kcal/kg/ngày, theo dõi sụt giảm Phospho Kali Magie 10%–30% trong 5 ngày (ASPEN Consensus Recommendations for Refeeding Syndrome)
abstract_snippet: decrease in any 1, 2, or 3 of serum phosphorus, potassium, and/or magnesium levels by 10%-20% (mild), 20%-30% (moderate), or >30%... occurring within 5 days of reintroduction of calories.
reason: ASPEN consensus defines criteria, stratification, and caloric advance restrictions (starting 80-100 kcal/kg/day) for managing refeeding syndrome.
